run.description: Import a pack into the yard: set the yard to what the pack says
does: pack synthetic (/synthetic/pack at sha256:935acc9aab245bf3737d907c5be763a6d0a9dc529b8cc403cbc6a58944d91ff0), of kind source, into the yard: it adds 1 source and copies 1 command file (1 command), and changes nothing else. It grants no call, makes no hook, and sets no credential's file.
source synthetic: its calls go to https://example.invalid. It names no credential.
call health (read): GET /health. It takes no parameter, and sends no query.
call health sends no body. Its answer is returned as it comes, at most 65536 bytes.
The source names no check call and no idempotency header.
its issues are no bead's link.
its identity keys keep their case.

what it sends in: deliveries are verified by the header X-Secret holding the hook's secret itself (scheme secret); it sends no delivery id; it sends no timestamp; bodies are unique; the command [bin/report] turns a verified body into the envelope, handed no credential; its events carry no field of their own.
it sends no pull-request or CI events.
command file bin/report: [bin/report] (hook.normalize, handed no credential): sha256 9d9adc8ea0ca1a4bd6955d136517cd0dd7e5f59a69f843bdbc9cc56818224ba4, mode 0700
